title: Clip domain model — ids, slugs, normalization,
result: `LIMITS`, `newClipId` (ULID), `slugify`, `normalizeMarkdown`, `sha256Hex`, `clipDirName`, `clipPath`, and the Zod schemas for clip metadata and clip state. `content_sha256` is the hash of the normalized markdown body only, so it stays stable across re-processing.
evidence: 10 tests passing, `pnpm typecheck` clean, TDD RED-then-GREEN evidence verified as genuine by the task reviewer.
